findings.area: assistant-fab overlapping agenda row (I DAG · Birmingham City – Barcelona)
findings.issue: The floating 'Assistent' button (fixed bottom-right pill/circle) sits directly on top of the 20:45 'Birmingham City – Barcelona' row, covering its ⓘ provenance icon and chevron in the bottom-right corner of the card. Confirmed with a plain (non-full-page) 375px viewport screenshot — this is what a real visitor sees on first load, not a full-page-stitching artifact. Same recurring bug flagged in the 2026-07-30 run (there it landed on a different row, 'Hradec Kralove - Tromso', because the agenda content shifts day to day) — the fixed-position button has no reserved safe area and will occlude whatever row happens to sit in its bottom-right corner.

findings.area: assistant-fab overlapping agenda row (I DAG · Bodø/Glimt – Lillestrøm)
findings.issue: Same fixed 'Assistent' pill lands one row lower here, covering the chevron and part of the 'Eliteserien · TV 2 ...' channel subtext of the 21:00 'Bodø/Glimt – Lillestrøm' row — tonight's featured Eliteserien match called out in the Morgenbriefen headline. Because the button is visually stacked on a tappable agenda row, a tap in that corner risks opening the assistant instead of the event detail sheet.

At this width the button renders as a labelled pill ('Assistent') that lands in the empty right-hand margin beside the agenda column (capped at 640px) and does not overlap any card text — no issue here. Confirms the bug is specific to narrow/full-width mobile viewports where there is no side margin for the FAB to live in.

notes: Correctness otherwise looked solid: no truncated Norwegian team/athlete names, every row shows a channel (TV 2 Play, TV 2, HBO Max (Sport), VG TV) or an honest '-', all Norwegian - no FOX/ESPN/Sky spotted. Multi-day events (PostNord Tour of Denmark, Tour de France Femmes, Tour de Pologne, Wyndham Championship) render with date ranges + 'neste: Etappe ...' framing instead of a single misleading time.

No broken image icons - team/sport glyphs render as small circular icons throughout (generic ball/flag glyphs for teams without a dedicated crest, e.g. KFUM Oslo, Lyn, Union Saint-Gilloise - consistent, not broken-image boxes).
Layout at 375/393 is otherwise a clean single column, no horizontal scroll, headings/dividers aligned, must-see accent dots used sparingly (4 of ~13 visible rows).

Header, Morgenbriefen headline, day groupings, 'Dette dekker vi'/'Merker og kilder' disclosures and footer (usage budget line, calendar subscribe, Aktivitet/Personvern links) all intact and readable at every width checked.

The assistant-fab overlap has now been observed on two consecutive runs (2026-07-30, 2026-07-31) on different rows each time - this is a structural bug (position: fixed with no bottom-content safe-area reservation and no viewport-width-based visibility change), not a one-off. Worth prioritizing for the ui-fix loop: e.g. add bottom padding to the agenda equal to the FAB's height + margin, or hide/shrink the FAB below a width breakpoint where it has no side margin to live in.
